comments.author: Anon
comments.text: So glad you’re continuing this series; I enjoy all your work, but I can’t wait to see what you do with this one!

comments.author: Ian
comments.text: I’m still going through the archives, so I don’t get a vote, but I get the feeling I’ll be asking for more Curious when I’m all done. Admirable and enviable storytelling, by which I mean I admire and envy your work. If you can go to med school and get master’s degrees while doing work like this, maybe I can find a way to make something this amazing while working toward my PhD. Thanks for the inspiration!
